headline: Steep Canyon Rangers play bluegrass in the moment, while still respecting its past.
summary: Discussing the state of bluegrass, Barrett Smith is likely to bring up jazz, or even the Grateful Dead. Improvisation – the jam band ethic – is a part of what has made Steep Canyon Rangers such a draw.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
